title: suncet-dev
description: SunCET public APID 1 development dashboard. AEPEX-inspired section layout. All queries disabled pending verified SatNOGS ingestion. Public schema SHA-256: 67d7da70c811f7dc88f6ea76f39ddf849c1378284c61596fffb13d74fe4bc128 Updated mission-owner reviewed layout, state colors and voltage bands.

options.content:
## Sun Coronal Ejection Tracker
**Development · awaiting telemetry integration**

No received SunCET data is connected yet. Empty panels are expected; no synthetic telemetry is displayed. This dashboard covers the public **CCSDS APID 1 / CTDB 2.0.5** beacon.

[Mission](https://suncet.jhuapl.edu/) · [SatNOGS DB](https://db.satnogs.org/satellite/MNRC-9829-4319-5529-8975) · [Beacon specification](https://github.com/suncet/suncet_processing_pipeline/blob/main/docs/SUNCET_PUBLIC_BEACON_SPEC.md)

**82 public fields · development layout.** State highlights and gauges await valid received telemetry.

panels.title: SunCET • spacecraft

options.content:
**Last valid reception:** unavailable · **Sample age:** unavailable · **Station / observation:** unavailable

Reception statistics will be connected after the SunCET source and timestamp semantics are verified. Voltage color bands are visual guides; no alert rules or freshness thresholds are configured.

panels.title: CDH mode
panels.description: Staged CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values; queries disabled pending ingestion verification. Source: mode_system_mode. Highlights only a recognized reported state. Unknown codes remain visible in the reported-value line; no state is selected for missing or unknown data. State colors follow mission-owner display preferences.

DN ranges assume offset 0 and width 32; update labels if configuration changes. Full image: 1504 × 2000 = 3,008,000 pixels; these six bins need not sum to that total.
